actual.value: - A total of 856 beneficiaries have received grants from the program. versus a target for the entire program period of 330 • Export revenues of grant beneficiaries have increased by EUR 5.6 million. which is an increase of 19.5% • Farmers receiving grants have increased their annual production by 5.425 tons and their annual revenues have increased by EUR 1.36 million • Cold store operators and processors having received grants have increased their annual volume of products handled by 22.526 tons and increased their annual revenues by EUR 5.7 million • Out of the total of 856 beneficiaries having received grants. 157 or 18.3% of the total are female. A total of 177 or 25% of the beneficiaries are defined as young persons
